ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Classes will be held from 6 to 9:15 PM on Tuesdays beginning January 19. There will be no class session on Tuesday March 23 due to UIUC spring break. Exams will be proctored at The Oakbrook Multi-University Center several times throughout the semester. Online synchronous Elluminate sessions (non face-to-face classes) are on 1/26, 2/2, 2/16, 2/23, 3/2, 3/9, 3/30, 4/13, and 4/20. There will be 4 Saturday labs from 10 AM to 4 PM at the Morton Arboretum in Lisle, IL on 1/30, 2/20, 3/6, and 4/2.
